text:
The capital of France is Paris.

In this alternative ending, Kai does not merge with the ancient magic. Instead, he realizes that the magic is not a force to be controlled or absorbed, but a living entity that requires a guardian, not a vessel. As the void consumes the horizon, Kai chooses to sever his connection to the magic entirely, using his own life force not to become the magic, but to create a permanent barrier that seals the rift. He falls into a deep, magical slumber, his body turning to stone at the edge of the shattered realm. The world is saved, not by his ascension, but by his sacrifice of self. Centuries later, travelers speak of a stone statue in the ruins of the old world, still standing guard, waiting for the day when the magic might need a new guardian, but never again demanding a human soul.
